wikitext.*: {{short description|American college basketball season}} {{Use American English|date=March 2026}} {{use mdy dates|date=February 2023}} {{Infobox college sports team season |mode=Basketball |year=2009–10 |team=Colorado State Rams |sex=men |image =Colorado State Script Logo.png |image_size =175 |conference=Mountain West Conference |division= |short_conf=MW |CoachRank= |APRank= |record=16–16 |conf_record=7–9 |head_coach=[[Tim Miles]] |hc_year=3rd |assoc_coach= |ahc_year= |asst_coach1=[[Niko Medved]] |ac1_year=3rd |asst_coach2=[[Craig Smith (basketball, born 1972)|Craig Smith]] |ac2_year=3rd |asst_coach3=DeMarlo Slocum |ac3_year=3rd |stadium=[[Moby Arena]] |champion= |tourney=[[2010 College Basketball Invitational|CBI]] |tourney_result=First Round }} {{2009–10 Mountain West Conference men's basketball standings}} The '''2009–10 Colorado State Rams men's basketball team''' represented [[Colorado State University]] in the [[2009–10 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The Rams were led by head coach [[Tim Miles]] in his third year leading the team. Colorado State played their home games at [[Moby Arena]] in [[Fort Collins, Colorado]], as members of the [[Mountain West Conference]]. The Rams finished conference play with a 7–9 record, earning the fifth seed in the [[2010 Mountain West Conference men's basketball tournament|Mountain West tournament]]. Colorado State lost in the quarterfinals of the MWC tournament to eventual tournament champion [[2009–10 San Diego State Aztecs men's basketball team|San Diego State]].{{cite web |title=San Diego State Avoids The Upset Against Colorado State |url=https://www.sbnation.com/2010/3/11/1368923/san-diego-state-colorado-state-mountain-west-tournament |last=Mauss |first=Jeremy |publisher=[[SBNation]] |date=March 11, 2010 |access-date=February 14, 2023}}{{cite web |title=San Diego St. 72, Colorado St. 71 |url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap/_/gameId/300700021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230214180223/https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap/_/gameId/300700021 |url-status=dead |archive-date=February 14, 2023 |agency=Associated Press |publisher=[[ESPN.com]] |date=March 11, 2010 |access-date=February 14, 2023}} Colorado State failed to qualify for the [[2010 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]], but were invited to the [[2010 College Basketball Invitational]]. The Rams were eliminated in the first round of the CBI by [[2009–10 Morehead State Eagles men's basketball team|Morehead State]], 74–60.{{cite web |title=Morehead State advances to CBI quarterfinals |url=https://www.kentucky.com/sports/college/mens-basketball/article44026509.html |work=[[Lexington Herald-Leader]] |date=March 18, 2010 |access-date=February 14, 2023}} The Rams finished the season
